params.prompt: Cinematic photoreal scene, square 1:1, dark warm palette (#0B0907 shadows). Lower half of the frame: seven tall dark glass showcase cabinets with brass edges in one row on a dark stone floor of a dark showroom, receding slightly from left to right but every cabinet fully visible, evenly spaced across the frame. Inside each cabinet one object stands on a dark pedestal. The first cabinet on the left glows warm yellow (#FDD506) from inside and holds an open laptop showing an abstract website layout with placeholder blocks. The other six cabinets stay dim, each object only hinted by a soft warm rim light: second - a folio of printed presentation pages and a mounted poster board with layout blocks; third - a vertical smartphone on a stand with a paused video and a tiny play icon; fourth - a calendar board with a grid of small pinned cards; fifth - a dark tablet with a rising bar chart; sixth - a small city map with a few tiny glowing pins and a magnifying glass; seventh - a smartphone with chat bubbles on screen. Thin haze, golden dust in the light beam, reflections on the polished floor. The upper 55% of the frame is nearly black and empty for typography. No people, no readable text, no letters, no logos, no watermark. Premium, calm mood.
